##### Project general facts

St. Regis, Al Maryah Island sets a new benchmark for ultra-luxury waterfront living, uniting the heritage of the St. Regis brand with the visionary craftsmanship of SAAS Properties. Positioned in Abu Dhabi’s most prestigious district, the development offers unmatched access to world-class retail, dining, and cultural destinations, all while delivering a serene canal-front setting with uninterrupted views toward Saadiyat Island. With its iconic architecture, refined lifestyle offerings, and privileged location connected directly to The Galleria, the project represents an elevated expression of convenience, prestige, and modern sophistication.

Crafted for discerning residents who seek exclusivity and timeless design, the project combines premium materials, meticulous detailing, and full-height glazing that frames sweeping skyline and waterfront vistas. Integrated smart-home technology, refined layouts, and the heritage of St. Regis anticipatory service ensure a lifestyle of seamless comfort. This is a residence where privacy, elegance, and urban vibrancy meet—shaping a home defined equally by luxury and purpose.

Residents enjoy an extensive collection of carefully curated amenities designed to enrich daily life. These include an infinity horizon pool, indoor and outdoor pools, a sanctuary spa with sauna, steam and cold plunge, elite fitness club, yoga and Pilates studios, a prestige cinema and media lounge, executive golf simulator lounge, squash court, signature residents' club, co-working lounges, treatment rooms, luxury retail boulevard, enchanted kids’ wonderland, cafés, community kitchen, library, and beautifully appointed guest suites. Thoughtful spaces such as the verdant staircase atrium and grand lobby arrival further enhance the sense of calm sophistication that defines the community.

Each residence is delivered with premium finishes, refined textures, and a contemporary palette that reflects understated luxury. Thoughtfully designed kitchens feature high-end cabinetry, integrated appliances, and elegant worktops, while living areas and bedrooms showcase quality flooring, bespoke joinery, and meticulous craftsmanship. The result is a home that balances aesthetic refinement with everyday practicality — offering a move-in-ready environment of comfort, elegance, and enduring style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Maryah Island, situated in Abu Dhabi, UAE, is a bustling urban center, formerly known as "Sowwah Island." Over recent years, it has transformed into a prestigious destination. Serving as Abu Dhabi's primary business district, it features high-rise office buildings and financial institutions. Luxurious residential options are also available, including upscale apartments and waterfront villas with breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf. Renowned for its world-class shopping and dining experiences, The Galleria offers high-end fashion boutiques and upscale restaurants. 

The island provides entertainment and leisure activities, with a waterfront promenade, cultural events, and beautifully landscaped parks. Al Maryah Island is also home to top-tier healthcare facilities like Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi and reputable international schools and universities. Well-connected to Abu Dhabi and the UAE through transportation networks, it offers easy access to key destinations and landmarks. Overall, Al Maryah Island seamlessly combines business, leisure, and luxury living, solidifying its status as a premier destination in Abu Dhabi.
